Flow.description: This flow will take information from the most recently added event related to a lead, and update the related lead record with appointment date, appointment time (GMT), and appointment time in Eastern Time.

formulas.description: This formula calculates the related event's time and converts it to Eastern Time, factoring in Daylight Savings Time, for entry in text format on the lead field Appointment Time.
formulas.name: EventTimetoleadinEasternTimewithDST
formulas.expression:
IF({!$Record.ActivityDate} >= DATE(YEAR({!$Record.ActivityDate}),3,(2*7+1)) - WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR({!$Record.ActivityDate}),3,8-1)) && {!$Record.ActivityDate} <= DATE(YEAR({!$Record.ActivityDate}),11,(1*7+1)) - WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR({!$Record.ActivityDate}),11,8-1)), TEXT(IF( OR( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 0, VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 12 ), 12, VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) - IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) <= 12, 0, 12 ) )) & ":" & MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 15, 2 ) & " " & IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 4/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, "AM", "PM" ),
TEXT(IF( OR( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 5/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 0, VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDate} - 5/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 12 ), 12, VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 5/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) - IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 5/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) <= 12, 0, 12 ) )) & ":" & MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 5/24 ), 15, 2 ) & " " & IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( {!$Record.ActivityDateTime} - 5/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, "AM", "PM" ) )

Flow.label: Event to Lead Appointment Update

recordUpdates.description: This flow will take data from the most recently added event related to a lead, and update the lead record with appointment date, appointment time, and appointment time converted to Eastern Time.
recordUpdates.name: Event_update_to_Lead
recordUpdates.label: Event update to Lead
